policy_cards.title: Payment webhooks must be idempotent
policy_cards.requirement: Payment webhook events must be processed at most once per event_id and duplicate events must not credit balances twice.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Successful payment events must be idempotent: the same event_id must be credited at most once.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly require duplicate event IDs to be ignored or processed once?
policy_cards.requirement_test: The same event_id must not be credited twice

policy_cards.title: Webhook event IDs are required
policy_cards.requirement: Payment webhook events must include a non-empty event_id.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Missing or empty event_id must fail without changing balances.
audit_questions: Does the spec require a non-empty event_id?
